rubrics.justification: Generally captures poor-quality morphology with poorly defined ICM and sparse TE, but it is somewhat inconsistent about stage, calling it less than a blastocyst despite the reported 1DD grade and transfer context; some image-based details are speculative.

Integrates age, endometrial thickness, ovarian response, smoking, prior live birth, recurrent ectopics, and male factor reasonably well, though AMH is unavailable and BMI/partner semen details are not deeply discussed.

Overall logic is understandable and the low prognosis estimate fits the poor morphology, but there are internal tensions about whether the embryo qualifies as a blastocyst and whether apparent collapse is artifact versus true poor development.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: respect lab grading, acknowledge poor prognosis of 1DD morphology, avoid routine PGT-A at age 29, and monitor closely given ectopic history. Minor speculative comments reduce full alignment.

Provides practical next steps including proceeding if this is the only embryo, luteal support, serial hCG/ultrasound, smoking/alcohol cessation, tubal/uterine evaluation, and review of cycle/lab factors; useful though not highly detailed.
